title: pypi-diff/20240526
summary: An automated daily archive of diffoscope-generated diffs between successive PyPI package releases, with no original functionality of its own. One captured diff shows the 'tabgan' package importing a vendored '_ctgan' module's CTGAN synthesizer as part of its release changes, so SDV-family code appears only incidentally inside a third-party package snapshot.
needs: This repo is an auto-generated diff archive; the CTGAN reference is inherited from the vendored tabgan package, not a deliberate SDV integration by this repo.
